preregistration: this file, committed before any generation (record-first). Issue #322 (ADR 0095 revisit trigger 2). Owner answers 12-Oct-2026, in-session: spend 'the rest of the $100' cap set for the 2026-10-12-skill-vs-bare-two-models batch. Decisions: ADR 0100 (author once, then retire), ADR 0101 (provenance split as a pre-registered secondary).
hypothesis: Neutral (ADR 0059): for each in-scope (skill, model) pair, appending the skill body to the system prompt may raise, lower, or leave unchanged the graded fraction of expectations met, versus the same model with no skill, on Claude Opus 5.5 and on Claude Sonnet 5.5. A null, a harmful result, or a model-dependent result are equally valid recorded outcomes.

scope.why: the five pairs below G=8 after the 12-Oct prescreen and grid (#322). building-skills on Opus (G=10) and engineering-principles (G>=8 on both) are out of scope.

arms.without: claude -p --model <M> --effort medium, isolation flags (--tools "", --disable-slash-commands, --strict-mcp-config, shared deny list), empty CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, cwd outside the checkout; hermetic_driver.NEUTRAL_FRAME + task text on stdin; CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=32000
arms.with: without + --append-system-prompt = treatments/<skill>.txt (live SKILL.md body at source_sha, frontmatter stripped)

effort: medium for both models (the harness's historical default; Opus 5.5's API default; one step below Sonnet 5.5's API default). Pinned so the model is the only thing that varies across the model factor.
instrument: scripts copied from 2026-10-12-skill-vs-bare-two-models at its committed state; changes are scope only (PAIRS, NEW_FROM_ID, selection merge, provenance split). Treatments re-frozen by prep.py and byte-compared against that dir's treatments (see treatments_match_12oct).

evals.source: evals/<skill>.json, frozen by prep.py from skills/<skill>/evals/evals.json

prescreen.rule: 1 bare rep per NEW eval (id >= 11) per in-scope model, graded before any with-arm cell. Bare fraction-met >= 0.85 = saturated -> dropped for that model only. Ids 1-10 carry the 12-Oct prescreen selection (same judge, instrument, and threshold; prescreen cells are never reused in the grid).
prescreen.g_floor: a (skill, model) with fewer than 8 surviving evals still runs, labelled DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY: it may retire or mark a claim UNDERPOWERED, never discharge debt for a KEEP (ADR 0095 decision 4)

pilot.rule: 2 with-arm cells per model on the first code-standards eval; per-model per-cell cost = mean of pilot and prescreen generation + judge per call (ADR 0073)

grid: surviving evals of in-scope pairs x {with, without} x 2 reps; a FRESH grid, no 12-Oct grid cell is reused (ADR 0100 rejected pooling)
judging: Claude Opus 5.5 judge, isolated identically, rubric.skill_grade_prompt per cell. Same family as the generators: every verdict here is FRAME-UNCHECKED (ADR 0093) and may not be promoted to a README KEEP until a cross-family judge (grok) grades the same committed cells via `grade.py --judges grok` and agrees. Self-preference risk is largest on the Opus cells; it affects both arms of a pair alike, so it biases levels more than deltas.
metrics: per (skill, model): eval-clustered mean of (with - without) fraction-met, mean over reps within eval; benchstats.keep_verdict (KEEP iff 95% t-interval lower bound > 0, HARMFUL iff upper < 0, else INCONCLUSIVE; practical bar 0) plus mde80. Primary: the 5 in-scope (skill, model) verdicts.
secondary_0101: provenance split of the (with - without) delta, pooled over (model, eval) clusters of in-scope pairs: original (ids 1-6), blind_12oct (7-10), blind_new (11+). Confirmatory comparison: blind_new 95% CI vs the original point estimate; ADR 0101 reopens iff the CI excludes it. ids 7-10 are reported but not used to confirm (they produced the post-hoc lead). Difficulty and provenance are confounded; bare levels are reported beside each.
stop_rule_0100: any in-scope pair with fewer than 8 surviving evals after this prescreen is recorded as UNMEASURED for its claim (its numbers may be cited as diagnostic only); no third authoring round.
multiplicity: 5 primary intervals at 95% each, no correction: about 0.25 false KEEP/HARMFUL calls expected under a global null.

cost.ceiling_basis: owner's $100 cap for 12-Oct minus about $45.7 billed by the 2026-10-12-skill-vs-bare-two-models batch (its README Costs), rounded down
